answer: Objective Quality Evidence (OQE) in the SUBSAFE program is defined as any statement of fact, quantitative or qualitative, about product/service quality based on observations, measurements, or tests that can be verified. OQE serves as the evidentiary foundation for the program, demonstrating that deliberate steps were taken to comply with requirements. Without OQE, there is no basis for certification, regardless of who performed the work or how well it was done.
